reasoning_content:
The server started on port 5195 (default), not 18080. The kestrel config from appsettings says 18080 but launchSettings likely overrides. Actually it says "Now listening on: http://localhost:5195" - that's from launchSettings.json. But `dotnet run` uses launchSettings. Let's check HTTP. The server is running. Let's verify it responds.

But the guide said `dotnet run -- server` should use conf.d/50_kestrel.json which sets port. In our case KPESTREL from appsettings.json (18080) but launch settings overrode. Actually "dotnet run" applies launchSettings. Let's test the endpoint.

action.command: sleep 2; curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:5195/ ; curl -sS http://localhost:5195/api/bovis | head -c 300; echo; echo "=== try 18080 ==="; curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:18080/ 2>&1 | head
